dataflow_review: Native loader returns [3,T,H,W] in sequential frame order; [:,:,:20] on batched tensor restricts network to passive frames0..19.
Known force is a separate reset rollout; overlapping frame numbers do not expose held-force observations to predictor.
Named native parameter output is frozen before replay and never updated after calibration.
Reference target bank is prospective two-world model prediction; indexed true-world evaluation happens only after qhat/risk are saved.
Primary MAP risk .5 differs from named NN risk1 because they assess different fixed point predictions.
All600 noise trials come from three geometry/two-world combinations; no independent-object performance claim.
scope: Coordinate RMS over21scalar coordinates, not point-Euclidean RMS; normalized scene coordinates, not mm.
Original GT-parameter replay is imperfect; no clean end-to-end accuracy superiority claim.
Runtime values are local wall-clock observations including synchronization/rendering/setup; not controlled speed comparison.
Native future image score is view0 pooled-MSE PSNR, whereas released-video control aggregates per-frame PSNR across4views; describe different protocols.
